items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: But all the guys we had, help man, was from New Orleans Yeah But the guys in his pay, I wouldn't for him So he felt close, he loved his man, but he was born to be like Phil Matthews Happy Ghosts All them guys knew when he was a boy, they all played around here together

ctx.x: Do you remember some of the better concerts? With Lloyd?

Yeah. I thought every concert Lloyd put on with a little bit. Yeah. Even when we were on the floor. We used to run with each other. And I left here at 32. I joined Don Howard's band. I was in San Antonio. Lloyd came through. It was a big band. And we was off that night. We ran in. And of course the whole band was. Who wanted to do. Yeah. All musicians were coming in. And we came down with a ton. And we were living there at some time. He was there to see us. Every show. I never saw Lloyd put on a bed. Yeah. The…
I guess New Orleans was really always a part of his temper and his style every place he went
